tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read the complete contents of a file from the workspace. Only works within the allowed directory.

path.description: Path to the file to read (relative to or within the allowed directory)

tools.name: list_directory
tools.description: List directory contents with [FILE] or [DIR] prefixes. Only works within the allowed directory.

path.description: Path to the directory to list

tools.name: search_files
tools.description: Recursively search for files and directories matching a pattern. Returns full paths of all matches.

tools.name: get_file_info
tools.description: Get metadata about a file or directory (size, timestamps, permissions).

path.description: Path to the file or directory
